title: Cannonball's live Somewhere
summary: Rowe offers to send Cannonball's live Somewhere as an example of heart and beauty.

blocks.x: Speaking about moving music, I wonder if you’ve heard Cannonball’s live version of “Somewhere.”
All right. Well I’m going to send it to you because —
You know you’ve been talking about the heart and beauty and that’s a good example of it.
I definitely want to hear that.
